f2d7adb1: If the response does not match any of the pre-defined multiple choice options, write the portion of the selected option that does match the entered response.
8261521a: If this is a POINTER field, set the input transform to look up the entry in the pointed-to file.
c7f5c2ff: If this is a numeric field, check if the entered value is too long. If so, reject the entry.
